= named-index-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-05
:source-highlighter: rouge
:acdc-index:
:label: https://example.org/attribute[Expanded]

== Name
named-index-subs - keep index delimiters with enabled substitutions

== Synopsis

[source,text,subs="+macros"]
----
S01 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/code[Link] after] end.
S02 indexterm2:[Before footnote:code[Code note.] after] end.
S03 indexterm:[Code,"link:https://example.org/hidden[Hidden, label]",Tail] end.
----

[source,text,subs="+quotes,+macros"]
----
S04 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/format[*Bold*] after] end.
----

[source,text]
----
S05 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/disabled[Literal] after] end.
----

[subs="none"]
S06 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/none[Literal] after] end.

[subs="macros,quotes"]
S07 indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/reordered[*Bold*] after] end.

[subs="attributes,macros"]
S08 indexterm2:[Before {label} after] end.

[subs="macros,attributes"]
S09 indexterm2:[Before {label} after] end.

S10 pass:m[indexterm2:[Before https://example.org/pass[Link\] after\]] end.

S11 indexterm2:[Before pass:q[*Protected*] after] end.

After footnote:code[].

[index]
== Index
